query.sql_select_query:
SELECT
    -- Account__c
    map_accounts.TargetId AS Account__c,
	
    -- CreatedById
    COALESCE(map_users_createdby.TargetId, '#{_dp('{"pill_type":"project_property","property_name":"default_user"}')}') AS CreatedById,
    
    -- CreatedDate
    source.CreatedDate,
    
    -- ExternalId__c
    REPLACE(LOWER(source.Name), ' ', '_') || ':' || map_accounts.TargetId AS ExternalId__c,
    
    -- ExternalId__c__if_duplicate
    -- This is used when there are duplciates so there is a known string to replace with row number
    REPLACE(LOWER(source.Name), ' ', '_') || '_{row_num}:' || map_accounts.TargetId AS ExternalId__c__if_duplicate,
    
    -- LastModifiedById
    COALESCE(map_users_lastmodifiedby.TargetId, '#{_dp('{"pill_type":"project_property","property_name":"default_user"}')}') AS LastModifiedById,
    
    -- LastModifiedDate
    -- Ensure not before created date
    CASE
        WHEN source.LastModifiedDate < source.CreatedDate
            THEN source.CreatedDate
        ELSE source.LastModifiedDate
    END AS LastModifiedDate,
    
    -- LegacyID__c
    source.Id AS LegacyID__c,
    
    -- Name
    source.Name,
    
    -- OwnerId
    COALESCE(map_users_owner.TargetId, '#{_dp('{"pill_type":"project_property","property_name":"default_user"}')}') AS OwnerId,
    
    -- Non-create fields
    source."AccountId__r.hasGroupACLs__c" AS SOURCE__AccountId__r__hasGroupACLs__c

FROM
    source

LEFT JOIN map_accounts
    ON source."AccountId__r.AccountNumber" = map_accounts.SourceNumber

LEFT JOIN map_users map_users_createdby
    ON source.CreatedById = map_users_createdby.SourceId

LEFT JOIN map_users map_users_lastmodifiedby
    ON source.LastModifiedById = map_users_lastmodifiedby.SourceId

LEFT JOIN map_users map_users_owner
    ON source.OwnerId = map_users_owner.SourceId

WHERE
    -- Ignore groups and labels whose accounts have not been migrated yet...
    -- those will be migrated via sync recipe instead
    map_accounts.TargetId > ''

query.sql_select_query:
WITH ranked_common AS (
    SELECT
        Account__c,
        CreatedById,
        CreatedDate,
        ExternalId__c,
        ExternalId__c__if_duplicate,
        LastModifiedById,
        LastModifiedDate,
        LegacyID__c,
        Name,
        '' AS OwnerId,
        
        -- Rank duplicates by ExternalId__c based on newest modification date
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ExternalId__c
            ORDER BY CreatedDate ASC
        ) AS row_num
    FROM
        common
    WHERE
        SOURCE__AccountId__r__hasGroupACLs__c = 'true'
)

SELECT
    Account__c,
    CreatedById,
    CreatedDate,
    
    -- Recalculate ExternalId__c for duplicates
    CASE 
        WHEN row_num > 1 THEN REPLACE(ExternalId__c__if_duplicate, '{row_num}', CAST(row_num AS VARCHAR))
        ELSE ExternalId__c 
    END AS ExternalId__c,
    
    LastModifiedById,
    LastModifiedDate,
    LegacyID__c,
    
    -- Recalculate Name for duplicates by appending the row number
    CASE 
        WHEN row_num > 1 THEN CONCAT(Name, ' ', CAST(row_num AS VARCHAR))
        ELSE Name 
    END AS Name,
    
    OwnerId
FROM
    ranked_common
